question: Explain the auditor's responsibilities under SA 570 when events or conditions cast significant doubt on the entity's ability to continue as a going concern, and how the audit report is affected.
sources: SA 705 Modifications to the Opinion in the Independent Auditor's Report

points.label: Management's assessment and basis of accounting
points.description: Financial statements are prepared on the going concern basis; management must assess the entity's ability to continue, normally for at least twelve months from the balance sheet date.
points.basis: SA 570, going concern basis of accounting and management's responsibility to assess going concern

points.label: Events or conditions that cast doubt
points.description: Gives examples of events or conditions: financial (net current liabilities, losses, loan defaults), operating (loss of key management or market) and other (legal proceedings, non-compliance).
points.basis: SA 570, examples of events or conditions that may cast significant doubt (application material)

points.label: Evaluating management's plans
points.description: Auditor evaluates management's plans for future action and cash flow forecasts, whether they are feasible and the outcome likely to improve the position, and performs additional procedures.
points.basis: SA 570, additional audit procedures when events or conditions are identified, including evaluating management's plans

points.label: Material uncertainty adequately disclosed
points.description: If a material uncertainty exists and is adequately disclosed, give an unmodified opinion with a separate section 'Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern'.
points.basis: SA 570, use of the going concern basis appropriate but a material uncertainty exists and is adequately disclosed

points.label: Inadequate disclosure or wrong basis
points.description: If disclosure is inadequate, express a qualified or adverse opinion; if management will not assess or extend its assessment, consider the effect on the audit and the opinion.
points.basis: SA 570 read with SA 705, inadequate disclosure of a material uncertainty and management unwilling to make or extend its assessment
